fact: Al Wasat reports the interior ministry of the Government of National Unity announced on 3 March 2024 the launch of a package of government e-services, including the start of an e-government portal project, with the Hawiyati portal still to be launched.
Libya's Passports, Nationality and Foreigners Affairs Authority says its e-visa unit received 773 applications in 23-29 October 2026, of which 610 were approved.

Cabinet Decision 705/2024 creates the Dawlati e-platform under the Government Communication Centre to provide e-services and issue official documents, with fees collected and documents verifiable by QR code.
